hypothesis: With the existing input-only normalized coordinate frame and unchanged input-conditioned learned coarse generator, training-only explicit coarse centroid/radius supervision reduces gross pose/contraction failures and improves complete missing-block surface coverage without worsening outliers or J support.
coordinate_frame: Frozen x=(world-c_D)/s_D, c_D/s_D from defective input only; GT uses same transform; do not add duplicate normalization
loss_definition: Lnew = unchanged coarse Chamfer + unchanged fine loss + 0.1 * 0.5 * (SmoothL1_beta0.1(||muQ-muG||/rG) + SmoothL1_beta0.1(log((rQ+eps)/(rG+eps)))) ; r=sqrt(mean squared radius+eps), matches existing implementation exactly
unchanged: 8k input/8k output/256coarse/V1 sampling/multi-boundary entity defect representation
existing coarse Chamfer and dense reconstruction coefficients
optimizer schedules numeric TF32 policy resource thresholds
evaluation protocol and E/J/CD/reverse20 risk thresholds

Only the changed loss branch on artificial GPU input; separately freeze 2forward/2backward/0optimizer budget if needed; no general inventory or repeat full preflight
Decide implementation and prospective M0_H1 C/D requests separately; assess all105development cases/fold; selected14 for explanations only

dense CD/reverse A2 P95/>20mm outlier fraction
all existing placement/compact/severe labels including new/rescued

conservative_descriptive_adoption_rule.additional_mechanism: coarse centroid mean and mean abs log-radius mismatch both improve; every case retained

falsification: Only moments improve, E/CD/coverage do not: moment constraint inadequate; stop H1, do not add loss terms automatically
Centroid improves but 008/random_2-type missing extent persists: spatial distribution beyond moments needed
Coarse improves but dense degrades: investigate residual generation, do not claim coarse hypothesis succeeded
Severe cases or reverse outliers worsen: reject overall improvement despite primary mean gain
Only one fold improves: retain fold-dependent result, no tuning/fold selection
limitations: Current code already has coarse Chamfer; loss_sparse=0 is denoising only, never claim absent coarse supervision
Existing centroid_radius branch is historical code, not method novelty
Input normalization is a coordinate reference, not localization evidence; hypothesis does not yet test a novel spatial anchor
Global moments cannot enforce topology, inner/outer surfaces, cutwall coverage or directional extent
Equal-moment wrong surfaces and complete collapse stationary radius gradients remain possible
Both dev folds have been inspected; results are exploratory, not independent confirmation; one seed and finite gradient nondeterminism remain
